title: JWTPayload
description: Claims required in a bearer JWT accepted by libs.auth.require_scopes (libs/auth/base.py). Verified against JWT_SECRET_KEY/JWT_ALGORITHM/JWT_ISSUER/JWT_AUDIENCE; see docs/AUTH.md.

sub.description: Subject - calling principal's user id. Stashed on request.state.user_id.

iss.description: Issuer. Must equal the service's configured JWT_ISSUER.

aud.description: Audience. Must equal the service's configured JWT_AUDIENCE.

scope.description: Space-separated scopes, e.g. 'orders:read orders:write'. Checked against each route's required scopes.

jti.description: Optional JWT id, passed through unchanged to TokenPayload.jti.
